detailed_description:
The target video is a 15-second Chinese-mythology 3D animated cinematic fragment in the quality style of a Chinese fantasy feature film: dark, oppressive, and epic, lit by molten glow from below and cold ambient blue from above, with editing rhythm accelerating from slow to frantic.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 3>: a wide establishing view of <Subject 3>, the dim underground lava cavern, where <Subject 1>, the giant grey-white dragon with dark stripe patterns, white mane, and long whiskers, sleeps coiled around the central stone pillar wrapped in layers of sagging rusted chains, lava glow flickering at the base of the pillar. <Subject 2>, the small white-haired youth in the red-black patterned robe, stands motionless on the rock ledge at lower right, his tiny figure a stark contrast to the dragon's massive bulk. The camera performs a slow rightward pan combined with a gradual push-in toward the confrontation, and the shot ends on <Picture 6>.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to <Picture 6>, the over-shoulder framing past the dragon's massive grey head — red scar streaks visible across its snout, long white whiskers hanging — toward <Subject 2> on the dark rock platform, a fiery lava wall glowing behind him. The camera holds the composition with a slight continued push-in. <Subject 1> slowly turns its head toward the youth's direction, its eyelids twitching, whiskers trembling, a low menacing rumble building in its throat; <Subject 2> raises his arm in a deliberate gesture. The camera then tilts down toward the dragon's claw, and the shot cuts to <Picture 5>.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to <Picture 5>, a close-up of the dragon's sharp dark claws against red-lit rock, pale scales at the right of frame. <Subject 1> suddenly drives its claws deep into the rock, crushing stones into fragments that scatter, the rusted chains swaying with the impact, dust and grit sifting down. <Subject 1> (S1) speaks in a low, mournful, weighted voice, <d>[Chinese] 我儿敖丙.</d> The shot cuts to <Picture 2>.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to <Picture 2>, an extreme close-up of the dragon's eye beneath a pale scaled brow with red crack-like markings on the snout. The molten orange-red vertical pupil snaps open, blazing like lava; the head rears back with high-speed motion-blur streaks, and the chains shake violently around it. <Subject 1> (S1) continues, its voice turning cold and furious, <d>[Chinese] 是龙族千年等待的机会，我.</d> The shot cuts to <Picture 1>.
[Shot 5] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to <Picture 1>, a vertical overhead wide of <Subject 3>: <Subject 1> thrashes madly at the center of the cracked, glowing lava floor, the rusted chains radiating outward stretched to their limit with visible fracture signs, the molten ground quaking, shards of rock debris slowly levitating upward around the pillar. <Subject 1> (S1) roars in a furious, thunderous voice, <d>[Chinese] 要让陈塘关.</d> The shot cuts to <Picture 4>.
[Shot 6] At 00:12.500, the shot cuts to <Picture 4>, a low-angle mid-shot of the dragon's pale scaled body and dark claws gripping the red-lit rock summit, chains silhouetted against the cold blue glow above. The camera pushes in as <Subject 1> keeps erupting with force: the thick chains wrapped around its neck snap with a violent crack and fly outward in slow, weighty arcs, links scattering. <Subject 1> (S1) delivers its final roar filled with killing intent, <d>[Chinese] 血债血偿.</d> The shot holds on the dragon's raging silhouette to the final frame.
